strings.name: Anthony Tan
strings.summary: After studying at Chicago and Harvard, Tan co-founded MyTeksi with Tan Hooi Ling and helped develop it into Grab. The company expanded from taxi booking into Southeast Asian mobility, deliveries and digital finance, then listed on Nasdaq. In 2026 it announced its first annual net profit, for 2025; his career illustrates regional platform financing, expansion and the transition toward profitability.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Grab and advanced Southeast Asian mobility, delivery and digital-finance platforms, influencing regional urban services and entrepreneurial ecosystems.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education

strings.highlights.h1.title: From taxi app to regional platform
strings.highlights.h1.text: Co-founded the venture with Tan Hooi Ling and led teams expanding mobility, delivery and financial services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Operational transition
strings.highlights.h2.text: In 2026 Grab announced its first annual net profit, for 2025; this is distinguished from adjusted EBITDA.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Announces first annual net profit
strings.timeline.t1.text: Grab reported 2025 net profit of $200 million, its first annual net profit, and adjusted EBITDA of $500 million.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Nasdaq listing
strings.timeline.t2.text: Grab began trading on Nasdaq following a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Acquires Uber’s Southeast Asian business
strings.timeline.t3.text: Grab acquired Uber’s Southeast Asian operations, extending its regional network.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Adopts the Grab brand
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company adopted Grab as its brand as services expanded beyond taxi booking.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Expands startup financing
strings.timeline.t5.text: A Harvard Business School account states that GrabTaxi had raised $340 million by December that year.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-launches MyTeksi
strings.timeline.t6.text: Launched the Malaysian taxi-booking app MyTeksi with Tan Hooi Ling.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completes Harvard MBA
strings.timeline.t7.text: Graduated from Harvard Business School, where the venture idea had developed.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns Chicago degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed undergraduate studies in economics and public policy.
